endpoints.notes: Chat2API audio conversation extension; consumes an owner-scoped audio_file_id and returns JSON audio/transcript data.
Custom chat2api-live-v1 full-duplex PCM/WebSocket protocol; not OpenAI Realtime WebSocket wire compatibility.
Issues a one-time 60-second Chat2API realtime session token; this is not the standard OpenAI client_secrets route.
GPT-Live speech generation returns JSON containing base64 audio and diagnostics; it does not implement the standard binary audio/speech response contract.
Text and supported uploaded image/file references. Default prompt_mode=full preserves the ordered multi-turn transcript. Client extension fields may appear in output.
Legacy text completions adapter over Chat Completions; prompt is converted to one user turn and usage remains estimated.
Supports standard multipart file upload for assistants, vision and user_data purposes, plus the legacy Chat2API JSON/base64 extension. batch/fine-tune/evals purposes are unsupported.
Returns standard FileDeleted {id, object, deleted}; owner-scoped.
Returns standard FileObject metadata (created_at Unix seconds, status=processed) with Chat2API mime_type extension; owner scoped.
Returns owner-scoped binary file bytes; no list endpoint is currently implemented.
Returns owner-scoped Chat2API generated-file metadata and signed download URL.
gpt-image only; requires active image-capable Worker and images scope.
Returns owner-scoped Chat2API media metadata and signed asset URLs; binary assets are served by /api/media capability URLs.
Only currently online model catalog; requires models scope.
Retrieves an online model from the current browser-backed catalog; offline or unknown models return not-found.
Owner-scoped native page snapshot sidecar; not an OpenAI Responses resource.
Owner-scoped native snapshot update SSE; presentation-only stream and not a generation terminal authority.
Text, native web search, hosted images and selected emulated tools via later patch layers; do not infer complete Responses feature parity.
Best-effort bounded in-process response store, not durable OpenAI storage semantics.

capabilities.evidence: Chat completion response with assistant message, stop, estimated usage.
SSE data frames; final stop chunk with usage, then [DONE]; extra status/reasoning deltas may occur.
system/developer/user/assistant/tool history converted into ordered prompt blocks; not native token/role handling by the upstream model.
Chat Completions tools/tool_choice are not guaranteed to yield OpenAI-native tool_calls; Responses emulation is separate.
Unknown Chat extras are accepted by Pydantic but JSON schema/response_format is not enforced at transport layer.
token_usage.usage_for estimator, not authoritative upstream OpenAI billing.
model in standard envelope is requested model; actual served-model evidence is tracked separately.
Typed response.created/response.completed/response.failed SSE; not Chat Completions [DONE].
Web search and image_generation with specific emulated function tools; arbitrary hosted tool compatibility not asserted.
Standard multipart files.create supported for assistants, vision and user_data; batch/fine-tune/evals unsupported; legacy JSON/base64 extension remains.
HTTPException and FastAPI request-validation failures under /v1 use {error:{message,type,param,code}}; endpoint-specific direct error responses still require contract tests.
Managed API-key scopes chat/models/files/images enforced by endpoints.
ModeResolverMiddleware defaults /v1 to mode2; mode1 rejected.
GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content returns owner-scoped binary content.
GET /v1/files list is not implemented.
Speech and realtime routes use Chat2API-specific request/response/wire formats; the legacy audio transcription route is not exposed by the composed app.
POST /v1/completions maps a prompt to the Chat Completions worker bridge.
The legacy v7 route is explicitly removed by v9 from the composed production app; no /v1/audio/transcriptions route is exposed.

Official Python and Node SDKs exercise POST /v1/images/generations against the real ASGI route with deterministic image.completed Worker output; real Chrome image generation remains an external release gate.
Model catalog aliases are normalized by app/model_catalog.py and applied to Worker dispatch; Python and Node SDK regression uses gpt-5-6-thinking -> gpt-5.6-sol.
Official Python and Node SDK retrieve a just-created stored Response; store is bounded in-process (256 records), not durable.

boundary.shared_request_service: M-02; no duplicate Worker terminal, auth, accounting, or media finality
out_of_scope: R native fidelity and Worker transport

POST /v1/chat/completions.name: model
POST /v1/chat/completions.evidence: Canonical model IDs and app/model_catalog.py aliases are normalized before Worker dispatch; the response retains the requested model ID.

POST /v1/responses.name: model
POST /v1/responses.evidence: v13 model alias normalization is applied to Worker dispatch; response model reports the requested ID.

POST /v1/responses.name: input
POST /v1/responses.evidence: String and selected input item/message forms are converted to an ordered Chat transcript; unsupported item shapes are rejected or ignored according to the parser.

POST /v1/responses.name: instructions
POST /v1/responses.evidence: String/list instructions are converted to a developer prompt section.

POST /v1/responses.name: stream
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Typed response.* SSE lifecycle events including response.created, output deltas and response.completed/failed.

POST /v1/responses.name: tools
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Native web_search/web_search_preview and the explicitly implemented image_generation tool path; unsupported tool types are rejected.

POST /v1/responses.name: tool_choice
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Only supported native tool selection/force behavior; arbitrary hosted tool choice is not guaranteed.

POST /v1/responses.name: include
POST /v1/responses.evidence: web_search_call.action.sources controls source inclusion; other include values are not guaranteed.

POST /v1/responses.name: store
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Controls a bounded in-process response store (maximum 256 records); not durable OpenAI storage.

POST /v1/responses.name: client_id
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Optional explicit Worker selection, subject to Registry routing and API-key binding.

POST /v1/responses.name: max_output_tokens
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object but not enforced as a Worker output-token limit.

POST /v1/responses.name: temperature
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object but not forwarded as a Worker generation control.

POST /v1/responses.name: top_p
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object but not forwarded as a Worker generation control.

POST /v1/responses.name: previous_response_id
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object but does not load or append a previous response to the prompt.

POST /v1/responses.name: parallel_tool_calls
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object but does not enable parallel hosted tool execution.

POST /v1/responses.name: text
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object; JSON schema/format enforcement is not implemented by the browser bridge.

POST /v1/responses.name: truncation
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object but does not control transcript truncation.

POST /v1/responses.name: metadata
POST /v1/responses.evidence: Returned in the Response object; not a durable metadata store or execution control.

POST /v1/images/generations.name: prompt
POST /v1/images/generations.evidence: Prompt is dispatched to an image-capable Worker.

POST /v1/images/generations.name: size
POST /v1/images/generations.evidence: Passed through to Worker options; actual size support depends on the connected Worker.

POST /v1/images/generations.name: response_format
POST /v1/images/generations.evidence: url and b64_json are accepted; URL mode uses Chat2API-owned media URLs.

POST /v1/images/generations.name: attachments
POST /v1/images/generations.evidence: Owner-scoped FileStore references used as image context.

POST /v1/files.name: file
POST /v1/files.evidence: Standard multipart upload; metadata/content/delete are owner-scoped.

POST /v1/files.name: purpose
POST /v1/files.evidence: Standard multipart purposes assistants, vision and user_data; batch/fine-tune/evals are rejected.
